dct_description_sm: The AAFC Infrastructure Flood Mapping in Saskatchewan 1 meter Bare Earth Hillshade is are the bare earth hillshades created at a 1 m interval for the capture area of Saskatchewan. The bare earth hillshade images were derived from the bare earth DEM. The hillshades were created using a 315 degree sun azimuth and 45 degree sun angle.
dct_title_s: AAFC Infrastructure Flood Mapping in Saskatchewan 1 meter Bare Earth Hillshade
